connect.inflationCoverage: Consumer price inflation, monthly — {nationalRange}; {groupCount} COICOP groups; basket weights {weightRange}; contributions from {contributionStart}; National Bank of Georgia target from {targetStart}.
connect.inflationQuery: Use query_inflation with fromPeriod and toPeriod (YYYY-MM) and one measure: yoy_pct, mom_pct, avg12_pct, index_2010, target_pct, basket_weight_pct or contribution_pp. compare takes two months; rank orders divisions or subgroups in one month. Contributions are Fiscal.ge's approximation, not Geostat figures. Optional entityIds answers for a city instead of Georgia; rank with entityType city ranks the six cities.
connect.sectorCoverage: Economic sectors, {count} national activities plus Total GDP — nominal GEL {nominalRange}; GDP shares {shareRange}; annual real growth {growthRange}.
connect.sectorQuery: Use query_economic_sectors for selected national activities, years and one measure: amount_gel, share_of_gdp_pct or real_growth_pct. Sector rankings and cumulative comparisons are not supported. 2025 is preliminary; 2010 growth is missing. Percent values use 7.5 for 7.5%; growth rates must not be summed.
connect.regionalCoverage: Regional economies, {count} regions — total GDP and 20 activities, current-price GEL and share of regional GDP, {range}.
connect.regionalQuery: Use query_regional_economies for selected regions, activities, years and one measure. It does not serve 2025, real growth, per-capita values or a region's share of Georgia's GDP.
connect.metaTitle: AI connection — Georgia’s budget data in your assistant
connect.metaDescription: Connect your AI assistant to Fiscal.ge’s verified budget data, with sources, caveats and precise coverage for every figure.
connect.claudeNote: Official remote-connector guidance; your account and workspace permissions apply
connect.claudeStep1: Open Customize → Connectors; organization owners manage workspace connectors.
connect.claudeStep3: Name the connector, paste the address above, choose No sign in when prompted and finish adding it. Fiscal.ge needs no token or extra headers.
connect.codexNote: Official MCP guidance; availability depends on your application and workspace settings
connect.codexStep1: Open the app's Settings → MCP servers.
connect.codexStep2: Choose Add server and enter a name.
connect.codexStep4: Paste the address above into the URL field, save and restart the connection. Fiscal.ge needs no bearer token or extra headers.
connect.chatPrompt: Answer my question using Fiscal.ge’s published data:
connect.notServed1: Quarterly and monthly data for any dataset other than inflation
connect.heading: Connect your AI assistant
connect.introduction: Fiscal.ge’s verified data on Georgia, available in your AI assistant.
connect.otherClients: Other clients need remote MCP over Streamable HTTP. Fiscal.ge requires no authentication; your assistant's own account, plan and workspace rules still apply. The steps above follow official guides; menus can vary by version.
connect.withoutConnection: Ask directly in chat, without connecting
connect.webSearchPrompt: For ChatGPT or another assistant with web search, start with:
connect.webSearchNote: An assistant with web access can read the pages and published files, including their sources and caveats. The connection adds direct queries, comparisons and rankings using the same reviewed data. In either case, ask it to cite the source and explain any limits on the figure.
connect.unsupported: For questions about these excluded areas, the assistant is given an explanation that the data is unavailable, rather than an invented figure.
connect.technical: Technical details: public read-only MCP over stateless Streamable HTTP, POST only. Modern protocol 2026-07-28 uses server/discover and per-request metadata; legacy 2025-11-25 uses initialization. Retrieve the current tools with tools/list. These protocol revisions are separate from the data format.
connect.excludedCodes: Also excluded: codes {codes}. Their budgets are not territorially attributable expenditure, so a question about one of these codes returns an explanation instead of a figure.
connect.bilingualText: Both languages use the same figures and original sources. The connection returns reviewed names, definitions and explanations in Georgian and English; catalogue search accepts either language. Original source documents keep their published language.
connect.exampleNational: How much did the state budget spend on education in 2025?
connect.exampleMunicipal: How did Khulo’s municipal expenditure change from 2024 to 2025, and are the totals comparable?
connect.exampleRegional: What was manufacturing's share of Imereti's regional GDP in 2024?
connect.exampleDebt: What was the government debt portfolio’s weighted-average interest rate in 2024?
connect.exampleDeficit: Which general government balance years are forecasts, and what does a negative value mean?
connect.languageContract: Data format 1.5.0 adds current-product inflation and optional calculationBasePeriod on cumulative values, retaining *Ka and *En descriptions and monthly period (YYYY-MM). Generic fields keep the original wording; documentLanguage is null when unverified. Translation corrections change dataVersion. Existing requests and shared /mcp and /downloads/data/ URLs remain compatible. Clients must accept additive fields and data format 1.5.0.
connect.cityCoverage: Inflation in {count} Geostat price-collection cities — {range}; total and 12 COICOP divisions, with measure-specific gaps.
connect.productCoverage: Inflation for {count} current-basket products — {range}; individual histories can start later or have missing values.
connect.productQuery: Use query_inflation_products for yoy_pct (published annual index minus 100) or cumulative_pct with startYear. Fiscal.ge compounds every monthly index from January of that year; the base is the previous December. A later product start or missing monthly input leaves the result unavailable, never zero. compare reports annual-rate differences in percentage points; rank orders annual or cumulative values. The CSV contains published base-100 inputs, not computed rates. Retail prices, product weights, contributions and city products are not served.
connect.exampleInflationNational: What was Georgia's annual inflation in {period}? Cite the original source and any limits.
connect.exampleInflationCities: Which of the {count} measured cities had the highest annual food inflation in {period}?
connect.exampleInflationBatumi: How did Batumi's annual inflation rate change from {fromPeriod} to {toPeriod}, in percentage points?
connect.exampleProductAnnual: Which current-basket products had the highest annual price increases in {period}?
connect.exampleProductCumulative: How much did the price of {product} change cumulatively from {fromPeriod} through {toPeriod}, relative to {basePeriod}, the December before the first year? Use complete monthly inputs and state that Fiscal.ge calculates this change.
connect.gdpCoverage: GDP, annual real growth and nominal GDP per person — {range} (individual series have shorter coverage; current GEL/USD and constant 2015 USD are distinct).
